summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Built a policy change register of eleven destination and origin policy items (Saudi localisation and kafala reform, other GCC labour rules, Malaysia foreign-worker freeze and FWCMS agency dispute, Korea EPS quota, Japan SSW/Employment for Skill Development, UK White Paper, Australia student-visa evidence level, Canada study-permit cap, OECD catalogue, Nepal's 2026 Gulf approval suspension). Each entry points to primary or near-primary leads (government press agencies, OECD IMO 2025, IOM MGI, ILO GB documents). No quota or cap levels are recorded; all are pending retrieval of primary texts. Several items are currently evidenced only by secondary/news sources and are flagged unverified.

findings.claim: Q1: Scheduled or proposed quota/visa changes in GCC destinations (Saudi localisation, kafala reforms, wage protection) and their effective dates.
findings.note: Required: primary legal texts (GLMM legal module, Saudi MHRSD decisions via SPA) with effective dates and occupational scope.

findings.claim: Q1: Malaysia foreign-worker freeze and FWCMS agency-listing rules affecting Nepal.
findings.note: Required: Malaysian Ministry of Human Resources / Home Ministry notices; Nepal MoLESS/DoFE notices (2026).

findings.claim: Q1: Korea E-9 quota 2026 and Nepal allocation; Japan SSW acceptance caps.
findings.note: Required: Korea MOEL quota decision; Japan Cabinet decision on SSW caps by field.

findings.claim: Q1: OECD student and skilled-worker pathway changes (UK, Australia, Canada) and implementation dates.
findings.note: Required: UK Statements of Changes to Immigration Rules; Australian Home Affairs evidence-level listing; IRCC cap allocation notice.

findings.claim: A policy change is recorded as 'scheduled' only when a primary legal or official text gives an effective date; otherwise 'proposed' or 'reported'.
Impact on Nepal is assessed only through measured flows of Nepali workers or students to the affected destination (from 23A or destination statistics); no elasticity is assumed in r1.

data_gaps: Primary texts for Malaysia's 2026 freeze and FWCMS listing not located (news only).
Korea MOEL 2026 EPS quota decision not located as a primary document (portal root only).
Australian Home Affairs evidence-level list URL to be confirmed on retrieval.
Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain, UAE, Qatar individual primary legal texts not individually located; GLMM legal module used as the index.
Student-visa grants to Nepali nationals by destination (flow data) not yet located; OECD IMO annex gives aggregated data only.
No official Nepal document on the 2026 Gulf approval suspension located.

assumptions.text: Policies are dated on the destination's calendar-year basis; linkage to Nepal FY flows is documented per entry.

challenges.text: Register entries PC-04 and PC-11 require DoFE monthly approvals for FY2025/26 to separate policy effects from conflict effects.

Exposure register lacks an entry for education-migration pathways (student visas to Australia, UK, Canada, Japan), which also drive remittances and outflows of skilled young people; propose adding one.
Simultaneous tightening in OECD student routes and GCC localisation could remove substitution options; request red-team review.

uncertainty: High. Register contents rest on located documents whose text has not been retrieved; several entries are evidenced only by news or secondary sources. Quota levels, effective dates and Nepali shares are pending.
